title: CaliMem: Search-Efficient Data Agent via Calibrated Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.34500v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data curation is a first-order design choice in machine learning, yet tailoring training data to a downstream model and task remains costly in labor, expertise, and compute. Datasets are therefore often processed through fixed pipelines and reused across applications. We show that this assumption is fragile: across 55 dataset--model tasks spanning biological domains, the same curation recipe can help one model while hurting another. Effective curation must adapt to the downstream setting, motivating automated search over data recipes. We first build an agentic system that searches for curation policies at deployment, improving data utility via \textit{test-time curation (TTC)}. Although achieving performance gains, its search is driven largely by recent feedback and remains local. translated_title: CaliMem：基于校准记忆的搜索高效数据智能体
translated_abstract: 数据整理是机器学习中一项首要的设计选择，然而为下游模型和任务定制训练数据在人力、专业知识和计算资源方面的成本依然高昂。因此，数据集通常通过固定的流水线进行处理，并在不同应用之间重复使用。我们证明这一假设是脆弱的：在跨越生物领域的55个数据集-模型任务中，同一种数据整理方案可能对某个模型有帮助，却对另一个模型有害。有效的数据整理必须适应下游场景，这促使我们对数据整理方案进行自动化搜索。我们首先构建了一个智能体系统，在部署阶段搜索数据整理策略，通过测试时整理提升数据效用。尽管取得了性能提升，但其搜索主要由近期反馈驱动且局限于局部。引入持久记忆有助于智能体在多次迭代中保留证据，同时也揭示了一个更深层次的问题：智能体会形成超出实际验证条件的结论……
tldr: 提出CaliMem数据智能体，通过校准记忆机制保留并校准跨迭代的证据，实现对数据整理方案的高效自动化搜索，使数据整理策略能够自适应地匹配下游模型与任务。
en_tdlr: CaliMem is a data agent that leverages calibrated memory to enable efficient, adaptive search over data curation recipes, addressing the finding that the same curation strategy can help one model while hurting another.
